messages:
maria (eng-releases): Heads-up: packaging + deploybot window for private-vpc RC6. Need a handshake between packaging, ops, and release for a fast-rollback path. ETA 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Who can sign off on checksums and image pins?
jake (release-engineering): I can sign. Are we pinning to v6.2.1 or doing a delta rebuild? Prefer a hard pin for predictable rollback.
sophia (packaging): Packaging here — we'll produce a sealed bundle + epoch manifest. Uploading to staging mirror by 05:30 UTC. We'll cosign and publish both sha256 and md5 for backwards tools.
maria (eng-releases): @sophia please include the cosign signer thumbprint and manifest TTL in the manifest. Ops needs the tarball sha256 in the release ticket for verification.
tom (onprem): Onprem ops — will need transit ETA and mirror update window. Also verify the installer has the k8s readiness probe fix included. For rollback, what's the fallback tag?
sophia (packaging): Fallback is previous-stable -> v6.1.9-hotfix. We'll push a `rollback-ready` tag and keep the previous manifest retainer for 6 hours post-deploy.
jake (release-engineering): Deploy-bot plan: canary 2% for 15m, then 25% for 30m, then 100% if green. Auto-abort on 5xx spike or p95 latency > 200ms. Fast rollback trigger is `/deploybot rollback <manifest>` in #release-bot; emergency immediate revert with `--emergency-rollback`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: RC6 -> private-vpc at 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z. Canary policy attached. Use `--emergency-rollback` to force immediate revert. Will post canary metrics to the release thread.
olivia (security): Security note — confirm KMS key for image encryption rotation is approved and include KMS thumbprint in the ticket. Audit logs retention for this customer must be set to 90d.
maria (eng-releases): Ack. @olivia we'll attach the KMS thumbprint to the release ticket. @tom can you stand by for the mirror handoff at 05:45 UTC and run checksum verify?
tom (onprem): Yes. I'll run `sha256sum /tmp/installer.tar.gz` and paste the result here, then start the mirror ingest and local verification.
tom (onprem): `d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e  installer.tar.gz` — matches manifest on staging. Mirror ingest OK :thumbsup:
sophia (packaging): Publishing release notes draft now: k8s probe fix, cert rotation, improved KV cache heuristics. Will attach to the ticket and push to docs site after canary passes.
jake (release-engineering): Quick reminder: if deploy-bot reports signer mismatch or manifest delta issues, do NOT force promote. Halt rollout and open a hotfix rollback. Keep manual approval gate enabled for the 25% -> 100% step.
maria (eng-releases): Final checklist: [x] sealed bundle uploaded, [x] cosign applied, [x] sha256 in ticket, [x] ops mirror check, [ ] canary monitor live, [ ] release notes publish. Everyone OK?
all: LGTM
all: :+1: :rocket:
